questions.question: Identify the correct form of the sentence with inversion required for emphasis. The committee's decision was what we had expected.
options: The committee's decision was what we had expected.
What we had expected was the committee's decision.
What we had expected the committee's decision was.
The committee's decision was expected by us.
questions.answer: What we had expected was the committee's decision.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the location of the meeting?
options: It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.
It was the conference room where we decided to postpone the meeting.
We decided to postpone the meeting in the conference room.
The postponement of the meeting was in the conference room.
questions.answer: It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the sentence using the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation.
If I were you, I would have accepted the offer.
options: If I were you, I would have accepted the offer.
If I was you, I would have accepted the offer.
If I had been you, I would have accepted the offer.
If I am you, I would have accepted the offer.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would have accepted the offer.

questions.question:
Which option correctly uses ellipsis to maintain parallel structure in the sentence?
She enjoys reading novels and hiking in the mountains, but he prefers watching films _____.
options: but he prefers watching films too.
but he prefers too watching films.
but he prefers watching films as well.
but he prefers too.
questions.answer: but he prefers watching films too.

questions.question:
Identify the correct formal register sentence for the given context.
It is imperative that the committee reviews the proposal before the deadline.
options: It is imperative that the committee reviews the proposal before the deadline.
It is imperative that the committee review the proposal before the deadline.
It is imperative that the committee will review the proposal before the deadline.
It is imperative that the committee have reviewed the proposal before the deadline.
questions.answer: It is imperative that the committee review the proposal before the deadline.
